cast.name: White Cast
cast.description: small fluffy chalky-white powder villain with a paint roller, smears ashy streaks on her cheek; squeaky, cackling, mocking little bully voice

cast.name: DERMDOC Sunscreen Tube
cast.description: the white DERMDOC Ultra Violet sunscreen tube with a lavender cap, team leader; cool, confident, slightly cocky cartoon voice

cast.name: Purple Tint
cast.description: smooth lavender droplet hero that jumps out of the tube; bright, sassy, bubbly cartoon voice

cast.name: SPF 50 PA+++ Shield
cast.description: polished cobalt-blue shield hero that blocks the UV ray villains; deep, calm, heroic bodyguard voice

cast.name: 4% Niacinamide
cast.description: silver-lavender molecule hero that clears the grey dullness haze; perky, confident team-player cartoon voice

lines.speaker: white_cast
lines.en: Now everyone can see your sunscreen!

lines.speaker: purple_tint
lines.en: Shoo! On the colour wheel I'm opposite yellow, so I cancel dullness.
lines.bn: হুশ! কালার হুইলে আমি হলুদের উল্টো, তাই ডালনেস ক্যানসেল করি!
lines.ta: ஓடு! கலர் வீல்ல நான் மஞ்சளுக்கு நேர் எதிர், அதனால டல்னஸ்ஸ கேன்சல் பண்றேன்!
lines.te: పో పో! కలర్ వీల్‌లో నేను పసుపుకి ఆపోజిట్, అందుకే డల్‌నెస్ క్యాన్సిల్!
lines.ml: പോ പോ! കളർ വീലിൽ ഞാൻ മഞ്ഞയുടെ എതിരാണ്, അതുകൊണ്ട് ഡൾനെസ് ക്യാൻസൽ ചെയ്യും!
lines.or: ଯାଅ ଯାଅ! କଲର ହୁଇଲରେ ମୁଁ ହଳଦିଆର ବିପରୀତ, ତେଣୁ ଡଲନେସ କ୍ୟାନସଲ କରେ!

lines.speaker: sunscreen_tube
lines.en: It blends right in. See the instant glow, not the sunscreen.
lines.bn: একদম মিশে যায়। ইনস্ট্যান্ট গ্লো দেখো, সানস্ক্রিন নয়!
lines.ta: அப்படியே கலந்துடும். இன்ஸ்டன்ட் க்ளோவ பாருங்க, சன்ஸ்க்ரீன இல்ல!
lines.te: పూర్తిగా కలిసిపోతుంది. ఇన్‌స్టంట్ గ్లో చూడు, సన్‌స్క్రీన్ కాదు!
lines.ml: നന്നായി അലിഞ്ഞുചേരും. ഇൻസ്റ്റന്റ് ഗ്ലോ കാണൂ, സൺസ്ക്രീനല്ല!
lines.or: ଏକଦମ ମିଶିଯାଏ। ଇନଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଟ ଗ୍ଲୋ ଦେଖ, ସନସ୍କ୍ରିନ ନୁହେଁ!

notes: Six spoken lines by five characters, matching the prompt's speaker labels. Line 1 'Haha!' is the White Cast villain's mocking laugh, kept original. White Cast is a small squeaky villain (orig f0 ~311 Hz), so villain fx with no extra pitch drop, to stay consistent with the kept laugh. The SPF Shield is the only deep voice (f0 ~98 Hz). Niacinamide (f0 ~205 Hz) sits close to the tube (~200-220 Hz), so it gets +2 semitones to stay distinct. The UV ray villains and the grey Dullness villain appear on screen but never speak. Whisper's single voice_cluster_hint was ignored.
